// Generated from factories/mothership/workflows/dispatch-control/factory_supervisor_tick.workflow-source.mjs. Do not edit by hand.
@import "../../../../factories/mothership/roles.stylesheet"

digraph factory_supervisor_tick {
    label = "factory_supervisor_tick"
    workflow_source = "factories/mothership/workflows/dispatch-control/factory_supervisor_tick.workflow-source.mjs"
    typed_action_transport_mode = "enforced"
    action_item_gate [shape="diamond" label="Action items to process?" recovery_owner="supervisor"]
    apply_rejected_upstream [type="tool" governance="irreversible" action_runtime="in_process" action_id="triage.apply_rejected_upstream" label="Apply rejected/superseded upstream closure" output_key="__apply_rejected_upstream_result" action_repo="${source_repo}" recovery_owner="supervisor" action_blocker_ref="${blockerRef}" action_issue="${source_issue_number}" trust_domain="mothership.local" trust_role="mothership.local.tool"]
    bug_fast_gate [shape="diamond" label="Open bugs? (fast route)" recovery_owner="supervisor"]
    bug_fast_resolution_gate [shape="diamond" label="Bugs resolved by fast route?" recovery_owner="supervisor"]
    count_ready_goals [type="tool" governance="reversible" action_runtime="in_process" action_id="common.count_json_items" label="Count ready goals" output_key="goal_count" recovery_owner="supervisor" trust_domain="mothership.local" trust_role="mothership.local.tool"]
    done [shape="Msquare" label="Done" recovery_sink_type="terminal"]
    emit_disposition_feedback [type="tool" governance="irreversible" action_runtime="in_process" action_id="artifact.emit_disposition_feedback" label="Emit disposition feedback to external-factory issues" output_key="__emit_disposition_feedback_result" recovery_owner="supervisor" action_manifest_path=".hatch/runs/${__run_id}/artifacts/release-manifest.json" trust_domain="mothership.local" trust_role="mothership.local.tool"]
    emit_review_metrics_summary [type="tool" governance="reversible" action_runtime="in_process" action_id="factory.review_metrics" label="Emit review metrics summary" output_key="__review_metrics_summary_result" action_factory_id="${factory_id}" recovery_owner="supervisor" action_lookback_hours="1" action_runs_dir="${runs_dir}" trust_domain="mothership.local" trust_role="mothership.local.tool"]
    ensure_goal_execution_path [type="tool" governance="reversible" action_runtime="in_process" action_id="goal.ensure_execution_paths" label="Ensure goal execution-path packets" output_format="json" outputs="goal_execution_path_count,goal_execution_path_records,goal_execution_paths" action_repo_root="${repo}" action_factory_id="${factory_id}" recovery_owner="supervisor" action_goal_issues="${kept_goals_limited}" trust_domain="mothership.local" trust_role="mothership.local.tool"]
    evaluate_action_item_gate [type="tool" governance="reversible" action_runtime="in_process" action_id="supervisor.action_item_gate" label="Check if supervisor review has work" output_format="json" outputs="has_action_items,action_item_count" action_repo="${target_repo}" action_factory_id="${factory_id}" recovery_owner="supervisor" action_control_plane_repo="${control_plane_repo}" action_runs_dir="${runs_dir}" action_target_repo="${target_repo}" trust_domain="mothership.local" trust_role="mothership.local.tool"]
    evaluate_external_factory_lifecycle [type="tool" governance="reversible" action_runtime="in_process" action_id="supervisor.external_factory_lifecycle" label="Evaluate external factory blocker lifecycle" output_format="json" outputs="lifecycle_state,reason,source_repo,source_issue_number,blockerRef" action_factory_id="${factory_id}" recovery_owner="supervisor" action_blocked_items="[]" action_control_plane_repo="${control_plane_repo}" action_source_repo="${target_repo}" trust_domain="mothership.local" trust_role="mothership.local.tool"]
    evaluate_open_bug_gate_after_fast [type="tool" governance="reversible" action_runtime="in_process" action_id="supervisor.open_bug_gate" label="Evaluate open bug gate after fast route" output_format="json" outputs="has_open_bugs,open_bug_count,parse_error" action_repo="${target_repo}" action_factory_id="${factory_id}" recovery_owner="supervisor" action_control_plane_repo="${control_plane_repo}" action_target_repo="${target_repo}" trust_domain="mothership.local" trust_role="mothership.local.tool"]
    evaluate_open_bug_gate_fast [type="tool" governance="reversible" action_runtime="in_process" action_id="supervisor.open_bug_gate" label="Evaluate open bug gate" output_format="json" outputs="has_open_bugs,open_bug_count,parse_error" action_repo="${target_repo}" action_factory_id="${factory_id}" recovery_owner="supervisor" action_control_plane_repo="${control_plane_repo}" action_target_repo="${target_repo}" trust_domain="mothership.local" trust_role="mothership.local.tool"]
    evaluate_tick_idle [type="tool" governance="reversible" action_runtime="in_process" action_id="supervisor.tick_idle_check" label="Check if tick has reporting work" output_format="json" outputs="tick_idle,tick_idle_reason" action_factory_id="${factory_id}" recovery_owner="supervisor" action_gh_repo="${gh_repo}" action_in_flight_count="0" action_runs_dir="${runs_dir}" action_selected_count="0" action_spawn_success_count="0" trust_domain="mothership.local" trust_role="mothership.local.tool"]
    external_lifecycle_gate [shape="diamond" label="External lifecycle rejected upstream?" recovery_owner="supervisor"]
    fan_in_goal_run [type="fan_in.dynamic" label="Collect goal runs" output_key="goal_runs" recovery_owner="supervisor" trust_domain="mothership.local" trust_role="mothership.local.fan_in.dynamic"]
    fan_out_goal_run [type="fan_out.dynamic" label="Run goals in parallel" recovery_owner="supervisor" source_key="kept_goals_limited" item_key="issue_number" template="packages/capability-goal-decomposition/workflows/goal_run/goal_run.workflow-source.mjs" max_concurrency="2" context_keys="capability_goal_decomposition_skills" trust_domain="mothership.local" trust_role="mothership.local.fan_out.dynamic"]
    fast_route_telemetry_clear [type="tool" governance="reversible" action_runtime="in_process" action_id="common.resolve_default" label="Record fast-route clear branch" output_key="fast_route_branch_marker" recovery_owner="supervisor" action_fallback="fast-route-clear" action_value="fast-route-clear" trust_domain="mothership.local" trust_role="mothership.local.tool"]
    fast_route_telemetry_open [type="tool" governance="reversible" action_runtime="in_process" action_id="common.resolve_default" label="Record fast-route open-bug branch" output_key="fast_route_branch_marker" recovery_owner="supervisor" action_fallback="fast-route-open" action_value="fast-route-open" trust_domain="mothership.local" trust_role="mothership.local.tool"]
    goal_decompose_backpressure [type="tool" governance="reversible" action_runtime="in_process" action_id="goal.decompose_backpressure" label="Check goal decomposition backpressure" output_format="json" outputs="decompose_allowed,decompose_skip_reason,executable_goal_count,max_concurrent_goals" action_repo="${gh_repo}" recovery_owner="supervisor" action_max_concurrent_goals="${max_concurrent_goals_pre}" trust_domain="mothership.local" trust_role="mothership.local.tool"]
    goal_decompose_gate [shape="diamond" label="Decompose goals this tick?" recovery_owner="supervisor"]
    goal_gate [shape="diamond" label="Any ready goals?" recovery_owner="supervisor"]
    keep_all_goals [type="tool" governance="reversible" action_runtime="in_process" action_id="goal.filter_kept_goals" label="Keep all ready goals" output_key="kept_goals" recovery_owner="supervisor" action_decisions="[]" action_issues="${goal_issues}" trust_domain="mothership.local" trust_role="mothership.local.tool"]
    limit_kept_goals [type="tool" governance="reversible" action_runtime="in_process" action_id="goal.limit_kept" label="Limit goal runs per tick" output_key="kept_goals_limited" recovery_owner="supervisor" action_kept_goals="${kept_goals}" action_max_goals_per_tick="${max_goal_runs_per_tick}" trust_domain="mothership.local" trust_role="mothership.local.tool"]
    list_ready_goals [type="tool" governance="reversible" action_runtime="in_process" action_id="goal.list_ready" label="List ready goals" output_key="goal_issues" action_repo="${gh_repo}" recovery_owner="supervisor" trust_domain="mothership.local" trust_role="mothership.local.tool"]
    load_intent_stack [type="tool" governance="reversible" action_runtime="in_process" action_id="common.resolve_intent_stack" label="Load intent stack" output_key="intent_stack" recovery_owner="supervisor" action_factory_root="factories/mothership" trust_domain="mothership.local" trust_role="mothership.local.tool"]
    load_supervisor_bug_fast_task_prompt [type="tool" governance="reversible" label="Load supervisor bug fast task prompt" output_key="supervisor_bug_fast_task_prompt" prompt="cat packages/factory-prompts/prompts/supervisor/bug_fast.md" recovery_owner="supervisor" trust_domain="mothership.local" trust_role="mothership.local.tool"]
    load_supervisor_review_task_prompt [type="tool" governance="reversible" label="Load supervisor review task prompt" output_key="supervisor_review_task_prompt" prompt="cat packages/factory-prompts/prompts/supervisor/review.md" recovery_owner="supervisor" trust_domain="mothership.local" trust_role="mothership.local.tool"]
    load_supervisor_rules [type="tool" governance="reversible" label="Load mothership supervisor addendum" output_key="supervisor_rules_content" prompt="cat factories/mothership/skills/supervisor_rules.md" recovery_owner="supervisor" trust_domain="mothership.local" trust_role="mothership.local.tool"]
    load_supervisor_skill [type="tool" governance="reversible" label="Load shared supervisor template" output_key="supervisor_skill_content" prompt="cat packages/factory-skills/skills/runtime/supervisor_review/SKILL.md" recovery_owner="supervisor" trust_domain="mothership.local" trust_role="mothership.local.tool"]
    load_supervisor_system_prompt [type="tool" governance="reversible" label="Load supervisor system prompt" output_key="supervisor_system_prompt" prompt="cat packages/factory-prompts/prompts/supervisor/system.md" recovery_owner="supervisor" trust_domain="mothership.local" trust_role="mothership.local.tool"]
    recovery_sweep_runtime [type="tool" governance="irreversible" action_runtime="in_process" action_id="factory.recovery_sweep" label="Sweep stale run/worktree residue" output_key="__recovery_sweep_runtime_result" recovery_owner="supervisor" action_apply="true" action_repo_path="${repo}" action_runs_dir="${runs_dir}" action_stale_minutes="20" recovery_sink_type="wait" trust_domain="mothership.local" trust_role="mothership.local.tool" action_branch_marker="${fast_route_branch_marker}"]
    release_manifest [type="tool" governance="irreversible" action_runtime="in_process" action_id="artifact.release_manifest" label="Emit release manifest" output_key="__release_manifest_result" action_run_id="${__run_id}" recovery_owner="supervisor" action_control_plane_repo="${gh_repo}" action_release_sha="${release_sha}" action_source_repos="${source_repos}" action_states="closed" trust_domain="mothership.local" trust_role="mothership.local.tool"]
    set_capability_goal_decomposition_skills [type="tool" governance="reversible" action_runtime="in_process" action_id="common.resolve_capability_goal_decomposition_skills_path" label="set capability_goal_decomposition_skills" output_key="capability_goal_decomposition_skills" recovery_owner="supervisor" trust_domain="mothership.local" trust_role="mothership.local.tool"]
    set_control_plane_repo [type="tool" governance="reversible" action_runtime="in_process" action_id="common.resolve_factory_config" label="Resolve control-plane repo" output_key="control_plane_repo" recovery_owner="supervisor" action_fallback="${target_repo}" action_key="control_plane_repo" trust_domain="mothership.local" trust_role="mothership.local.tool"]
    set_date [type="tool" governance="reversible" label="Set current date" output_key="date" prompt="date -u '+%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ'" recovery_owner="supervisor" trust_domain="mothership.local" trust_role="mothership.local.tool"]
    set_date_fast [type="tool" governance="reversible" label="Set current date (bug fast route)" output_key="date" prompt="date -u '+%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ'" recovery_owner="supervisor" trust_domain="mothership.local" trust_role="mothership.local.tool" branch_marker="${fast_route_branch_marker}"]
    set_gh_repo [type="tool" governance="reversible" action_runtime="in_process" action_id="common.resolve_default" label="Resolve control-plane repo" output_key="gh_repo" recovery_owner="supervisor" action_fallback="${target_repo}" action_value="${target_repo}" trust_domain="mothership.local" trust_role="mothership.local.tool"]
    set_max_concurrent_goals_pre [type="tool" governance="reversible" action_runtime="in_process" action_id="common.resolve_factory_config" label="Resolve max concurrent goal runs (pre-goal gate)" output_key="max_concurrent_goals_pre" recovery_owner="supervisor" action_fallback="3" action_key="max_concurrent_goals" trust_domain="mothership.local" trust_role="mothership.local.tool"]
    set_max_goal_runs_per_tick [type="tool" governance="reversible" action_runtime="in_process" action_id="common.resolve_factory_config" label="Resolve max goal runs per tick" output_key="max_goal_runs_per_tick" recovery_owner="supervisor" action_fallback="2" action_key="max_goal_runs_per_tick" trust_domain="mothership.local" trust_role="mothership.local.tool"]
    set_release_sha [type="tool" governance="reversible" label="Resolve release SHA from main branch" output_key="release_sha" prompt="git rev-parse main" recovery_owner="supervisor" trust_domain="mothership.local" trust_role="mothership.local.tool"]
    set_source_repos [type="tool" governance="reversible" action_runtime="in_process" action_id="common.resolve_default" label="Resolve source repos" output_key="source_repos" recovery_owner="supervisor" action_fallback="${target_repo}" action_value="${source_repos}" trust_domain="mothership.local" trust_role="mothership.local.tool"]
    set_supervisor_factory_identity [type="tool" governance="reversible" action_runtime="in_process" action_id="common.resolve_factory_config" label="Resolve supervisor factory identity" output_key="factory_id" recovery_owner="supervisor" action_fallback="mothership/factory_supervisor" action_key="factory_id" trust_domain="mothership.local" trust_role="mothership.local.tool"]
    set_target_repo [type="tool" governance="reversible" action_runtime="in_process" action_id="common.resolve_default" label="Resolve target repo" output_key="target_repo" recovery_owner="supervisor" action_fallback="${gh_repo}" action_value="${target_repo}" trust_domain="mothership.local" trust_role="mothership.local.tool"]
    snapshot_state [type="tool" governance="reversible" action_runtime="in_process" action_id="supervisor.state_snapshot" label="Snapshot factory issue state" output_key="state_snapshot" action_repo="${target_repo}" action_factory_id="${factory_id}" recovery_owner="supervisor" action_control_plane_repo="${control_plane_repo}" action_runs_dir="${runs_dir}" action_target_repo="${target_repo}" trust_domain="mothership.local" trust_role="mothership.local.tool"]
    snapshot_state_fast [type="tool" governance="reversible" action_runtime="in_process" action_id="supervisor.state_snapshot" label="Snapshot bug queue before tick work" output_key="state_snapshot" action_repo="${target_repo}" action_factory_id="${factory_id}" recovery_owner="supervisor" action_control_plane_repo="${control_plane_repo}" action_runs_dir="${runs_dir}" action_target_repo="${target_repo}" trust_domain="mothership.local" trust_role="mothership.local.tool"]
    start [shape="Mdiamond" label="Start"]
    supervisor_health [type="tool" governance="irreversible" action_runtime="in_process" action_id="supervisor.health_check" label="Supervisor health check" output_key="__supervisor_health_result" action_repo="${gh_repo}" action_factory_id="${factory_id}" action_run_id="${__run_id}" action_pipeline="factory_supervisor_tick" recovery_owner="supervisor" action_runs_dir="${runs_dir}" trust_domain="mothership.local" trust_role="mothership.local.tool"]
    supervisor_review [class="supervisor" benchmark_job_id="supervisor.tick.review" llm_path_id="mothership.supervisor.review" prompt_version="2026-03-09.r1" role_version="1.0.0" skill_id="supervisor.review" label="Supervisor LLM review" timeout="120m" prompt="${supervisor_system_prompt}\n\nFactory target: ${target_repo}\nDate: ${date}\n\nFactory context:\n- factory_id=${factory_id}\n- target_repo=${target_repo}\n- control_plane_repo=${control_plane_repo}\n- gh_repo=${gh_repo}\n\nSupervisor template (shared):\n${supervisor_skill_content}\n\nFactory-specific addendum:\n${supervisor_rules_content}\n\nState snapshot:\n${state_snapshot}\n\n${supervisor_review_task_prompt}" recovery_owner="supervisor" prompt_input_keys="target_repo,date,factory_id,control_plane_repo,gh_repo,supervisor_skill_content,supervisor_rules_content,state_snapshot" prompt_source="supervisor_review_task_prompt" session_id="supervisor-${factory_id}" system_prompt_source="supervisor_system_prompt" task_prompt_source="supervisor_review_task_prompt" workdir="."]
    supervisor_review_bug_fast [class="supervisor" benchmark_job_id="supervisor.tick.bug_review_fast" llm_path_id="mothership.supervisor.review_bug_fast" prompt_version="2026-03-09.r1" role_version="1.0.0" skill_id="supervisor.review_bug_fast" label="Supervisor bug fast-route" timeout="120m" prompt="${supervisor_system_prompt}\n\nFactory target: ${target_repo}\nDate: ${date}\n\nFactory context:\n- factory_id=${factory_id}\n- target_repo=${target_repo}\n- control_plane_repo=${control_plane_repo}\n- gh_repo=${gh_repo}\n\nIntent stack JSON:\n${intent_stack}\n\nSupervisor template (shared):\n${supervisor_skill_content}\n\nFactory-specific addendum:\n${supervisor_rules_content}\n\nState snapshot:\n${state_snapshot}\n\n${supervisor_bug_fast_task_prompt}" recovery_owner="supervisor" prompt_input_keys="target_repo,date,factory_id,control_plane_repo,gh_repo,intent_stack,supervisor_skill_content,supervisor_rules_content,state_snapshot" prompt_source="supervisor_bug_fast_task_prompt" session_id="supervisor-${factory_id}" system_prompt_source="supervisor_system_prompt" task_prompt_source="supervisor_bug_fast_task_prompt" workdir="."]
    sync_release_manifest [type="tool" governance="irreversible" action_runtime="in_process" action_id="factory.publish_control_plane_manifest" label="Sync manifest to canonical location" output_key="__sync_release_manifest_result" recovery_owner="supervisor" action_manifest_path=".hatch/runs/${__run_id}/artifacts/release-manifest.json" trust_domain="mothership.local" trust_role="mothership.local.tool"]
    tick_idle_gate [shape="diamond" label="Tick idle (goals running, no changes)?" recovery_owner="supervisor"]
    update_tick_idle_cursor [type="tool" governance="reversible" action_runtime="in_process" action_id="supervisor.tick_idle_cursor_update" label="Advance tick-idle cursor (end of tick)" output_key="__tick_idle_cursor_result" action_factory_id="${factory_id}" recovery_owner="supervisor" trust_domain="mothership.local" trust_role="mothership.local.tool"]
    evaluate_tick_idle -> tick_idle_gate
    recovery_sweep_runtime -> list_ready_goals -> count_ready_goals -> goal_gate
    set_release_sha -> release_manifest -> sync_release_manifest -> emit_disposition_feedback -> emit_review_metrics_summary -> evaluate_external_factory_lifecycle -> external_lifecycle_gate
    start -> set_gh_repo -> set_target_repo -> set_control_plane_repo -> set_supervisor_factory_identity -> set_source_repos -> load_supervisor_skill -> load_supervisor_rules -> load_supervisor_system_prompt -> load_intent_stack -> snapshot_state_fast -> evaluate_open_bug_gate_fast -> bug_fast_gate
    update_tick_idle_cursor -> done
    action_item_gate -> load_supervisor_review_task_prompt [condition="has_action_items=true"]
    action_item_gate -> update_tick_idle_cursor [condition="has_action_items!=true"]
    apply_rejected_upstream -> evaluate_tick_idle
    bug_fast_gate -> fast_route_telemetry_clear [condition="has_open_bugs!=true"]
    bug_fast_gate -> fast_route_telemetry_open [condition="has_open_bugs=true"]
    bug_fast_resolution_gate -> done [condition="has_open_bugs=true"]
    bug_fast_resolution_gate -> recovery_sweep_runtime [condition="has_open_bugs!=true"]
    ensure_goal_execution_path -> set_capability_goal_decomposition_skills
    evaluate_action_item_gate -> action_item_gate
    evaluate_open_bug_gate_after_fast -> bug_fast_resolution_gate
    external_lifecycle_gate -> apply_rejected_upstream [condition="lifecycle_state=rejected_upstream"]
    external_lifecycle_gate -> evaluate_tick_idle [condition="lifecycle_state!=rejected_upstream"]
    fan_in_goal_run -> set_release_sha
    fan_out_goal_run -> fan_in_goal_run
    fast_route_telemetry_clear -> recovery_sweep_runtime
    fast_route_telemetry_open -> set_date_fast
    goal_decompose_backpressure -> goal_decompose_gate [input_key="goal_issues"]
    goal_decompose_gate -> keep_all_goals [condition="decompose_allowed=true"]
    goal_decompose_gate -> set_release_sha [condition="decompose_allowed!=true"]
    goal_gate -> set_max_concurrent_goals_pre [condition="goal_count!=0"]
    goal_gate -> set_release_sha [condition="goal_count=0"]
    keep_all_goals -> set_max_goal_runs_per_tick
    limit_kept_goals -> ensure_goal_execution_path
    load_supervisor_bug_fast_task_prompt -> supervisor_review_bug_fast
    load_supervisor_review_task_prompt -> supervisor_review
    set_capability_goal_decomposition_skills -> fan_out_goal_run
    set_date_fast -> load_supervisor_bug_fast_task_prompt
    set_date -> evaluate_action_item_gate
    set_max_concurrent_goals_pre -> goal_decompose_backpressure
    set_max_goal_runs_per_tick -> limit_kept_goals
    snapshot_state -> set_date
    supervisor_health -> snapshot_state
    supervisor_review_bug_fast -> evaluate_open_bug_gate_after_fast
    supervisor_review -> update_tick_idle_cursor
    tick_idle_gate -> supervisor_health [condition="tick_idle!=true"]
    tick_idle_gate -> update_tick_idle_cursor [condition="tick_idle=true"]
}
